periodRule.terra-only-estimated: before Aqua: Terra-only MODIS x Terra->Terra∪Aqua factor
periodRule.viirs-estimated: VIIRS reference x stratified MODIS/VIIRS ratio (day, night) combined with overlap factor rho

selection.rule: Pre-registered (v2): quantile mapping if its leave-one-year-out monthly MAE is strictly lower than the stratified ratio's; otherwise the stratified ratio.

qm.basis: x = VIIRS reference day + night cell-days (S-NPP scale), m = MODIS any-time cell-days, whole-region training months

interval90.note: Multiplicative bounds from held-out (leave-one-year-out) residuals of the selected method, region-scale monthly totals; small AOIs add Poisson sampling noise (z·sqrt(estimate)).

viirsLevel.basis: VIIRS reference any-time cell-days on the S-NPP scale where a full VIIRS month exists; otherwise MODIS-equivalent x training ratio for the month of year (estimated)
